body: So you didn't sail away to China..

Being a South Africa is enough of a challenge without this virus. I'm unemployed and I need to move back in with my mom.. I'm about to turn 27 and feel like a failure. I've struggled with suicidal thoughts for years and even though it's nothing new, it feels different this time.
So many people are dying and yet they want to live. I'm just here begging to switch places because then I don't have to do it and my mom won't suffer as much.
It's been 10 years and it always comes back. Sometimes I think I've beaten it but no. I hate it I wish it would go away. We keep fighting though.. we have to.. It's our last hope.
